description: ESG (Empirical Sensitivity Gramian) visualization: computes the ESG matrix for selected layers (0, 6, 12, 18, 23) of Qwen3.5-0.8B by collecting Jacobians across calibration samples and forming G = J^T @ J. Visualizes eigenvalue spectra (log-scale) and top eigenvectors as heatmaps. Reveals the sensitivity structure of each layer — how many directions carry meaningful signal.
